Premises:
∀x (Student(x) ∧ WorksInLibrary(x) → ¬FromCSDept(x)) ::: No students who work in the library are from the computer science department.
∀x (PartTimeJob(x) → (Student(x) ∧ WorksInLibrary(x))) ::: All students with part-time jobs offered by the university are students who work in the library.
∀x (TakesDatabaseCourse(x) → FromCSDept(x)) ::: All students who take the database course are from the computer science department.
∀x (InstructedBy(x, david) → TakesDatabaseCourse(x)) ::: All students instructed by professor David are taking the database course.
∀x (WorksInLab(x) → InstructedBy(x, david)) ::: All students working in the lab are instructed by professor David.

Conclusion:
HasPartTimeJob(James) ::: James has a part-time job offered by the university.
